TC-SEL-001.actual: Account step: accepted ("Account Submitted!"). Seller application (shop name, description, Metro Manila (NCR) > Quezon City > Commonwealth, street, National ID, selfie, business permit, DTI certificate): accepted with no errors; the page changed to "Under Review – We're reviewing your application". The application "Maria Clara Handicrafts" is saved with status pending. Emails: Welcome to Loved-IT!; Your Loved-IT Seller Application Has Been Received. No OTP was sent and no email verification page opened.
TC-SEL-001.remarks: Design difference (A9, A12): no email OTP; the application goes straight to admin review. In Loved-IT a seller first creates a Loved-IT account at /register (name, email, mobile, password) and then applies at /register/seller (shop details and documents). The form has no Shop Category, Seller Type, TIN, Region or Postal Code fields, and no BIR 2303 upload; the LGU Business Permit was filled with mayors_permit.pdf and the description with a short text, which the system requires. The test-data domain example.com is rejected by the system's email check (it has a null MX), so the same address was used with @gmail.com; mail went to the isolated test log only. Screenshot: TC-SEL-001.jpg Recovered evidence from the prior recorded browser run; reviewed in this continuation, not rerun as a fresh account test.
